title: Jubilant Basque Squid Skewers
description: Salty, crunchy, monsoon-inspired Basque squid skewers marinated in miso and finished with a zesty lime glaze, perfect for a macrobiotic-friendly feast.
instructions: Whisk miso paste, rice vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil, lemon zest, lime juice, chili flakes, and salt in a bowl until smooth.
Add the squid rings to the bowl and let them marinate for 15 minutes.
Thread the marinated rings onto soaked wooden skewers, leaving a small gap between each ring.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Place the skewers on the grill and cook for 3 minutes on each side or until the squid turns opaque and slightly charred.
Remove the skewers and immediately drizzle with a small amount of extra sesame oil for shine.
Serve hot, garnished with a sprinkle of fresh cilantro if desired.
Optional: squeeze a little extra lime juice over the skewers before serving.
Enjoy the crunchy, salty, and citrusy flavors of Basque-inspired squid skewers.
